items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Toby, Otto Hardwick, he and I became very good friends.

ctx.x: Oh, he was a doll. He drank a little too much, but who didn't, you know, in those days. Toby, you know, used to have that big bass saxophone beside him. I said, 'What have you got that thing there for?' And he said, 'Come up on the bandstand after we finish the set and I'll show you.' Well, they had the showgirls that came up there, around on a platform, around in back of the band and down the sides like that. He had a mirror fixed up on the saxophone, the bass saxophone, so he could see all the girls up there.
